title: 项目复盘后，怎样把反馈变成下一轮行动
topic: 项目复盘后，怎样把反馈变成下一轮行动

source.title: Sprint Retrospective: How to Hold an Effective Meeting | Atlassian
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课聚焦 Atlassian Sprint Retrospective 的五步流程：营造不责备的氛围、收集反馈、找出反复出现的趋势、确定改进并分配负责人和期限、总结行动。
paragraphs: At the beginning of the meeting, encourage people to respectfully share their open and honest thoughts throughout the session, focusing on improvement instead of blame.

Make it clear what will happen with the information discussed during the retrospective. Will it stay within the group? Will it be shared with leadership? Consider adopting the Chatham House Rule to help team members feel safe and comfortable.
Once you’ve set the tone and expectations for the meeting, you can gather team members' feedback on how the last sprint went. There are many ways to do this, including:
💬 Open group discussion about what went well and what didn’t

One of the biggest obstacles to a sprint retrospective is when team members don’t share enough feedback. In addition to creating a safe space, try guiding the conversation with a simple structure like the 4Ls or Sad, Mad, Glad. You can also try collecting anonymous submissions.
If someone is dominating the conversation, call on others for their thoughts to make sure everyone gets their voice heard.

As a group, look for patterns and trends in the feedback. What did we learn? What changes could we make to build on the good things and minimize or avoid the bad things? These insights are key to setting goals and making improvements, so encourage everyone to contribute any they may have.
Sprint retrospectives are about improving your next sprint, so focus more on patterns and trends vs. one-time mistakes or successes that likely won’t happen again.
Now, it’s time to turn insights into action. This is where you can start setting goals and determine what changes to make for future sprints.
As you document changes and action items, be sure to assign owners and deadlines to kickstart progress.

Rather than (or in addition to) writing action items on a sticky note or digital document, enter them directly into your sprint planning or project management system, such as Jira or Trello, so they’re already incorporated into your plans.
Wrap up your sprint retrospective by thanking everyone for their contributions and sharing a summary of key takeaways and action items. Then, on to the next sprint!

Don’t let your retros become stale, check-the-box, and let’s get outta here exercises that serve no purpose. There are various ways to encourage conversation, so experiment and see what works best for your group. Here are nine of our favorite sprint retrospective exercises.
translations: 复盘开始时，请鼓励成员尊重、坦诚地分享想法，把重点放在改进而不是责备上。
明确告诉大家，复盘讨论的信息之后会如何处理；这有助于让成员安心分享。
在说明基调和预期后，收集团队对上一轮冲刺的反馈。
全体讨论哪些方面做得好、哪些方面不理想。
可以使用匿名或署名问卷。
复盘的一大障碍是成员提供的反馈不足；可用简单结构或匿名反馈帮助大家表达。
如果有人主导了太多讨论，可以邀请其他人说说想法，确保每个人都有发言机会。
团队一起从反馈中找出模式和趋势：学到了什么？可以做哪些改变？
复盘要改进下一轮，因此应关注模式和趋势，而非可能不会重现的一次性失误或成功。
接下来把洞察转化为行动，确定未来冲刺要做的改变。
记录改进措施和行动项时，要指定负责人和期限，以便推动执行。
可以把行动项直接加入冲刺计划或项目管理工具，而不只记在便签或文档上。
结束复盘时，感谢所有人的参与，并分享要点和行动项摘要。
不要把复盘变成走过场；可以尝试不同练习，让团队持续愿意参与。
fullTextParagraphs: At the beginning of the meeting, encourage people to respectfully share their open and honest thoughts throughout the session, focusing on improvement instead of blame. (This is key to developing psychological safety and a blameless culture.) To help, add Loom AI to your meeting to capture notes so that your team can focus on the retro itself.
Lastly, encourage your team to chat with Rovo as a thought partner if they have any concerns around tone or messaging of feedback.

Make it clear what will happen with the information discussed during the retrospective. Will it stay within the group? Will it be shared with leadership? Consider adopting the Chatham House Rule to help team members feel safe and comfortable.
Once you’ve set the tone and expectations for the meeting, you can gather team members' feedback on how the last sprint went. There are many ways to do this, including:
💬 Open group discussion about what went well and what didn’t
🗒️ Surveys (anonymous or attributed)
❤️ 4 Ls retrospective: Discuss what everyone loved, loathed, learned, and longed for during the last sprint
🙂 The Sad, Mad, Glad framework: Discuss what made team members feel each of those emotions. What was disappointing? Frustrating? Exciting and encouraging?
Use Rovo Search to gather relevant pages or tickets to help contextualize the feedback.

One of the biggest obstacles to a sprint retrospective is when team members don’t share enough feedback. In addition to creating a safe space, try guiding the conversation with a simple structure like the 4Ls or Sad, Mad, Glad. You can also try collecting anonymous submissions.
If someone is dominating the conversation, call on others for their thoughts to make sure everyone gets their voice heard.

As a group, look for patterns and trends in the feedback. What did we learn? What changes could we make to build on the good things and minimize or avoid the bad things? These insights are key to setting goals and making improvements, so encourage everyone to contribute any they may have.
Sprint retrospectives are about improving your next sprint, so focus more on patterns and trends vs. one-time mistakes or successes that likely won’t happen again.
Use Rovo Chat to distill the feedback into key patterns and trends.
Now, it’s time to turn insights into action. This is where you can start setting goals and determine what changes to make for future sprints.
As you document changes and action items, be sure to assign owners and deadlines to kickstart progress.

Rather than (or in addition to) writing action items on a sticky note or digital document, enter them directly into your sprint planning or project management system, such as Jira or Trello, so they’re already incorporated into your plans.
If any of the action items have corresponding tickets or issues, include those links on the retrospective page and/or tasks so it's easy to see the status.
Convert the feedback, patterns, and insights into actionable next steps with AI chat.
Wrap up your sprint retrospective by thanking everyone for their contributions and sharing a summary of key takeaways and action items. Then, on to the next sprint!

Don’t let your retros become stale, check-the-box, and let’s get outta here exercises that serve no purpose. There are various ways to encourage conversation, so experiment and see what works best for your group. Here are nine of our favorite sprint retrospective exercises.

notes.phrase: focusing on improvement instead of blame
notes.meaning: 把重点放在改进而不是责备
notes.explain: 复盘先建立讨论基调，谈流程和改进，不把问题变成对个人的指责。
notes.example: Let’s keep the discussion focused on improvement instead of blame.

notes.phrase: look for patterns and trends in the feedback
notes.meaning: 从反馈中寻找模式和趋势
notes.explain: 反复出现的问题通常比一次性意外更适合转成下一轮的流程改进。
notes.example: We looked for patterns and trends in the feedback from three sprints.

notes.explain: 负责人知道自己要做什么，期限让团队可以跟进。
notes.example: Let’s assign owners and deadlines to the two changes we selected.

scenario.title: Summarizing a sprint retrospective
english: Simulation: The team has just completed a sprint for a checkout update.
The release candidate passed its core checks once the sample data was ready. In each of the last three sprints, testers waited for sample data at the start. The next sprint begins on Wednesday.
Write a short retrospective summary that recognizes what went well, names the recurring pattern, and records one next-sprint action with an owner and deadline.
chinese: 模拟情境：团队刚完成一次结账流程更新冲刺。
样例数据就绪后，候选版本顺利通过核心检查；但过去三轮冲刺的测试人员都在开始时等样例数据。下一轮冲刺周三开始。
写一段简短复盘总结：肯定做得好的地方，指出反复出现的模式，并记录一项下一轮行动、负责人和期限。

firstAttempt.prompt: 模拟复盘：结账流程候选版本在样例数据准备好后通过核心检查；过去三轮测试都曾因样例数据未就绪而等待。请用英文总结一项成功、一项重复出现的问题，并为下一轮确定一个具体改动、负责人和期限（下轮周三开始）；最后感谢团队并说明会回顾行动。
firstAttempt.sample: Thanks, everyone. What went well was that the release candidate passed the core checks once the sample data was ready. One pattern we noticed was that testers waited for sample data at the start of each of the last three sprints. For the next sprint, Leah will publish the test-data set by Tuesday afternoon, before the sprint begins on Wednesday. We’ll add this action to the sprint plan and check it at our next retrospective.
firstAttempt.rationale: 复盘总结要从反馈找出重复趋势，再把一个改动落实到负责人和期限，并留下后续检查方式。项目细节均为模拟。

words.example: We’ll review the action at our next retrospective.
words.translation: 我们会在下一次复盘时检查这项行动。
words.note: 这里指冲刺结束后回顾工作并确定改进的会议。

words.example: We noticed a pattern across the last three sprints.
words.translation: 我们在过去三轮冲刺中发现一个重复模式。
words.note: 复盘要找可能重现、值得改流程的问题。

words.example: Add the test-data task as an action item in the sprint plan.
words.translation: 把准备测试数据的任务作为行动项加入冲刺计划。
words.note: 行动项把改进建议转成可执行任务。

words.collocation: assign an owner and a deadline
words.example: Assign an owner and a deadline to each agreed change.
words.translation: 为每项商定的改动指定负责人和期限。
words.note: 来源要求将改进措施落实到具体负责人和期限。

structure.original: As a group, look for patterns and trends in the feedback.
analysis: 这是祈使句，省略主语 you，look 是主要动词。
look for 表示“寻找”；patterns 和 trends 是并列宾语，in the feedback 说明寻找的范围。
复盘时用这句话把讨论从单个意见推进到反复出现的现象。
structure.transfer: We found one pattern across three sprints: testers waited for sample data each time.

rewrite.bad: The sprint had one problem, so the team should be more careful next time.
rewrite.good: Thanks, everyone. What went well was that the release candidate passed the core checks once the sample data was ready. One pattern we noticed was that testers waited for sample data at the start of each of the last three sprints. For the next sprint, Leah will publish the test-data set by Tuesday afternoon, before the sprint begins on Wednesday. We’ll add this action to the sprint plan and check it at our next retrospective.
rewrite.translation: 谢谢大家。做得好的一点是，样例数据准备好后，候选版本通过了核心检查。我们发现一个反复出现的情况：过去三轮冲刺开始时，测试人员都在等样例数据。下一轮冲刺周三开始前，Leah 会在周二下午前发布测试数据集。我们会把这项行动加到冲刺计划里，并在下一次复盘时检查。
rewrite.pattern: What went well was [result]. One pattern we noticed was [recurring issue]. For the next sprint, [owner] will [action] by [deadline].

cloze.prompt: What went ___ was that the release candidate passed the core checks.
cloze.why: 用 What went well 回顾有效结果。

cloze.prompt: As a group, look for patterns and ___ in the feedback.
cloze.why: 来源建议一起找反馈中的 patterns and trends。

cloze.prompt: Assign ___ and deadlines to kickstart progress.
cloze.why: 将改进对应到具体负责人和期限。

dictation.text: At the beginning of the meeting, encourage people to respectfully share their open and honest thoughts throughout the session, focusing on improvement instead of blame.
As you document changes and action items, be sure to assign owners and deadlines to kickstart progress.

translationPractice.prompt: 做得好的一点是候选版本通过了核心检查。
translationPractice.answer: What went well was that the release candidate passed the core checks.
translationPractice.why: 把复盘中的回顾、趋势和行动落实清楚。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们发现一个反复出现的情况：过去三轮冲刺中，测试人员都在等待样例数据。
translationPractice.answer: One pattern we noticed was that testers waited for sample data in each of the last three sprints.
translationPractice.why: 把复盘中的回顾、趋势和行动落实清楚。

translationPractice.prompt: 下一轮冲刺周三开始前，Leah 会在周二下午前发布测试数据集。
translationPractice.answer: For the next sprint, Leah will publish the test-data set by Tuesday afternoon, before the sprint begins on Wednesday.
translationPractice.why: 把复盘中的回顾、趋势和行动落实清楚。

choice.prompt: 复盘时，大家提到某项任务曾有一次延误，也发现过去三轮冲刺都在同一环节等待数据。接下来怎样讨论更有助于改进？
options: 只讨论那一次延误，要求相关同事以后更仔细。
聚焦反复出现的等待，确定改进任务，并为它指定负责人和期限。
记录所有抱怨，但不选下一步行动。
choice.why: Atlassian 建议关注可重复出现的模式，并把改进转成有负责人和期限的行动项。

output.prompt: 模拟迁移：客户支持团队完成一次新客户入职冲刺。做得好的是客户资料按计划导入；过去三次交接中，支持人员都缺少客户首选联系渠道。下一轮于周五开始。请写一段复盘总结：说明成功、指出反复模式、给下一轮安排一项有负责人和期限的改进，并感谢团队。
output.sample: Thanks, everyone. What went well was that the customer records were imported on schedule. One pattern we noticed was that support staff were missing each customer’s preferred contact channel in the last three handoffs. For the next sprint, Luis will add that field to the handoff checklist by Thursday afternoon, before the next cycle begins on Friday. We’ll review the checklist at our next retrospective.
check: 是否感谢团队并说出做得好的地方？
是否指出反复出现的模式而非单次失误？
是否为下一轮明确行动、负责人和期限？
是否说明后续复核方式？
